svg.aria-label: Blind detector of sudden mass changes
svg.title: Blind detector of sudden mass changes
svg.text: A blind search of 24 years of gravity for sudden mass changes
Each month: the strongest standardised step anywhere on Earth (likelihood-ratio scan for 400 and 800 km caps). Dashed: the false-alarm threshold
from time-shifted data. Orange: USGS earthquakes of magnitude 8 or more (taller for larger). The catalogue was not used in the search.
